newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs due for correction, prop at 130.20.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs due for correction, prop at 130.20.

text.p: June BTP futures are vulnerable to a correction on Tuesday and will find minor support at 130.58 before a stronger prop at 130.20, technical analysts said.
"The market certainly looks like it's due for a phase of consolidation, if not a healthy corrective move," said Louise Jones, fixed income analyst at Technical Data here.

She said channel resistance at 131.45 had contained the market well over recent weeks and would likely continue to do so, at least until Tuesday's U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting was out of the way.
By 0747 GMT, June BTPs were down 0.08 at 130.69.
Jones put minor support at 130.58, around current lows, but added that could come under threat, since BTPs outperformed strongly on Monday.
Below there, stronger channel support comes in at 130.20, she said.

"It all depends on the outcome of the FOMC. The prospect of an (Italian) rate cut is keeping the market supported, but this is largely priced in, so if the FOMC decides to hike, it could spark a healthy correction back down to 128.00, 128.50."
To the upside, above 131.45, the next resistance is the contract high of 131.76, reached on January 23.
Analysts at MCM YieldWatch agreed BTPs were under corrective selling pressure, with the move back through 130.62 opening a pullback to 130.48/33.
"But losses are still seen as corrective, ahead of a rally to test 131.76 contract highs," they said in a note.
But they said a move below 130.33 would negate the positive mood and turn the outlook bearish. Overall, they suggested investors wait for a better risk/reward trading opportunity.
By 0801 GMT, June Eurolira was down one basis point at 93.38.
RSI - 14 day -- BTPs 66.4 pct, Eurolire 63.6 pct
